_comment: SPEC §1 + §26. This file is the single source of truth for the applicant profile. It is read fresh on every run; edit it and rankings change. Never edit scoring code to fix a profile problem.

identity.self_fund_note: Confirmed able to self-fund ~EUR 40-50k (source: user, Aug 2026).

domains: technology deployment in a regulated environment

english.note: Indian B.Tech taught in English. Many EU universities accept an MOI letter; many do not. Treat exemption as PROBABLY AVAILABLE, never VERIFIED, unless the programme page says so.

tests.gmat_note: Changed 2026-10-03. Was false, set in August. Evidence it is now wrong: an active GMAT training system has been under development in ~/Movies/gmat-780-ai since September 2026 (122 tests passing, ~690 practice items), which only makes sense if the GMAT is being taken. Flagging rather than assuming: if the GMAT is NOT actually planned, set this back to false and every MBA returns to REJECT - ELIGIBILITY.

hard_constraints._comment: SPEC §2. These are non-negotiable and are enforced as hard rejects, not soft penalties.

objective.seed_target_identity: AI Governance & AI Risk Manager for financial institutions, specialising in KYC/AML, payments, customer-data platforms and regulatory compliance

balance._comment: SPEC §53. 1.0 = pure money maximisation, 0.0 = pure purpose/impact.

context_notes: Age/career stage: ~10 years post-graduation. Programmes that require a recent bachelor or that cap work experience are a mismatch risk - check explicitly.
A master's is being bought partly as an IMMIGRATION INSTRUMENT (post-study work rights + salary-threshold qualification), not only as education. Score accordingly.

Ireland Critical Skills permit threshold is materially lower WITH a relevant degree. A B.Tech in Biotechnology is unlikely to count as relevant to a governance role - this is the single strongest argument for the master's.

An MBA/EMBA track was added on 2026-10-03. This is a genuine strategic fork, not an extension of the governance-master's plan: MBAs cost 2-3.5x the stated self-funding ceiling, require the GMAT, and lead to consulting/finance/general management rather than AI governance. The engine scores both so the trade-off is explicit rather than assumed.
